title: Who is allowed to train for work at height?
lines: Not just anyone can issue a work-at-height permit.
Training must come from a recognized body, with a certified instructor.
A certificate from an unrecognized body? At an inspection it's worth nothing.
Our instructor is certified, and the permits are in order.
Come in person, learn, and sleep easy. Ofek At Tal.
disclaimer: This video is not official training|and does not replace training and hands-on practice|and is not a work-at-height permit|a reminder only
